title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is a typed page, numbered 99, of Exposé IX of SGA 7 I (Grothendieck, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie', §8.3). It is not part of the handwritten notes on divided-power de Rham complexes and t-structure-like truncations τ_N on the neighbouring pages. Its own page stamp is 417, so it appears to be a stray sheet filed in cote 136.

Setting, as I understand it. A_K is an abelian variety over the fraction field of a henselian discrete valuation ring. For each finite separable extension K' (K ⊂ K' ⊂ K''), A^♮_{K,K'} is a smooth group of finite type attached to the Néron model of A over K' together with its descent data. I am not certain of Grothendieck's exact definition from the page alone.

Step by step:
- For K' ⊂ K'' there is a canonical open immersion A^♮_{K,K'} ↪ A^♮_{K,K''} (8.3.1). So the A^♮_{K,K'} form an inductive system of smooth groups of finite type whose transition maps are open immersions.
- Hence the component groups Φ_{K,K'} = A^♮_{K,K'}/A^{♮o}_{K,K'} (8.3.2) form an inductive system of finite étale groups.
- Define A^♭_K = lim_{K'} A^♮_{K,K'} (8.3.3) as an fppf sheaf. Because the transitions are open immersions, the limit is a group scheme, locally of finite type and in general not quasi-compact.
- Its identity component and component group are given by (8.3.4): A^{♭o} = A^{♮o}, and A^♭/A^{♭o} ≅ lim Φ_{K,K'}.
- Section 11.10 shows this limit is canonically M_K ⊗ Q/Z. Here M_K is the character lattice of the toric part, notation (8.1.8). This reflects the standard fact: after a ramified extension of index e, the monodromy pairing defining Φ is multiplied by e, so in the limit the component groups exhaust M ⊗ Q/Z.

Purpose: to describe the 'stable' Néron model and component group over the maximal (tame) extension, as input to the theory of the monodromy pairing.
errors: The typescript itself has a typo: 'dans le système inductif envisagé dans des immersions ouvertes' should read '... envisagé sont des immersions ouvertes'. There is no mathematical error.
Minor notational inconsistency in the typescript: 'les A_{K,K'}' appears without the ♮.

ideas.what: Inductive system of smooth groups A^♮_{K,K'} with open-immersion transition maps; colimit A^♭_K representable by a non-quasi-compact group scheme
ideas.modern_name: Colimit of Néron models over finite extensions; locally finite type group scheme with component group lim Φ

ideas.what: Limit of component groups lim_{K'} Φ_{K,K'} ≅ M_K ⊗ Q/Z
ideas.modern_name: Stable component group / behaviour of Néron component groups under ramified base change (monodromy pairing)

missed.claim: Archival observation only: this typed page of SGA 7 Exp. IX is misfiled among the handwritten notes of cote 136 on the divided-power de Rham complex. There is no mathematical novelty.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Useful only for cataloguing: the page belongs with SGA 7 typescript material, not with the 1975-76 crystalline/PD notes.

deep.surprise_reason: The content is verbatim published material from SGA 7 I, Exposé IX §8.3, and the result it announces (11.10) is also published there.
transcription_corrections: 'envisagé dans des immersions ouvertes' is faithful to the typescript but is a typo for 'sont des immersions ouvertes'.
In 'les A_{K,K'} forment ainsi un système inductif' the image indeed shows no ♮ superscript; this is consistent with the typescript.
The page number stamp is 417 (and 259 in pencil); the page header is '- 99 -' and 'IX', identifying it as SGA 7 Exposé IX.
